notes.title: Shield Spell and Skill Tree Improvements
notes.content:
Today I’m sharing some of the tweaks I’m making while working on the overall game balance.

Shield Spell
First, the shield spell is getting an adjustment: instead of being a permanent shield, it will now last for 5 seconds. To compensate, the cooldown (CD) will be reduced from 40 to 20 seconds. These times are still subject to change as I continue testing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f21d6a90add179ad446cbc5567ef5a52df57e5c4.gif

This will make the spell much more strategic, rather than something you just use every time the cooldown resets.


Skill Tree Selection
Several people (unfortunately I don’t have their names noted) suggested it would be better if selected upgrades in the skill tree were marked with a circle to make them clearer. After trying different styles, here’s how it will look in the next update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/64ae4eb12a459d051ddfa9708adeab0eba956b9d.png

I hope you like these changes. See you next week with more updates!

notes.title: What’s Coming in Version 1.5.0
notes.content:
Last week we said goodbye to the Toledo Matsuri event, but it's not all bad news, I'm here to talk about version 1.5.0.

Toledo Matsuri was a great experience for me, as it was my first time participating in a live, in-person event. Thanks to that, and to all the feedback I received, I noticed that some aspects of the game could use a bit of refinement. Specifically, the tileset graphics and the overall game balance. Let’s dive a bit deeper into these two areas.

The Lich’s Vision
Tileset Graphics

For those unfamiliar with the term, a tileset is a collection of graphics used for the environment—floors, walls… and in this case, I’m referring to the floors in Countless Army.

At launch, Countless Army looked slightly different. I made a small visual improvement to reduce visual noise, but I feel that wasn’t quite enough. Here’s a small preview of what’s coming:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f2cbd37b7ac31fe1955cb45241424ca0f6fb4d73.gif

As you can see, the floors and paths have been simplified to make them less visually overwhelming. It’s still in development, so I’d really appreciate any feedback or suggestions you may have.

This update will apply to every map in the game.

The Lich’s Balance
Game Balance

Do you think there's a troop that feels too weak or too strong? Would you like to see any unit tweaked or reworked in some way? Drop a comment. I’ll consider your suggestion for update!

Watching people play live made me realize that troop stats need a proper review. That’s why, in the next update, I plan to go over all unit attributes… and also defenses.

This process will be quite interesting, as I’m even considering adjusting the "CD" stat so that, instead of marking distance between divisions, it will define the spacing between units within a division.

If you enjoy the more technical side of things, I’d love to publish a devblog-style post with deeper insights into this topic, so stay tuned.

These are the main changes coming in version 1.5.0, but they won’t be the only ones!

Thank you all so much for playing Countless Army!

notes.title: 1.4.0 is here!
notes.content:
Countless Army dresses up in Japanese theme to attend Toledo Matsuri!
[previewyoutube=VrwpQzsrw_k;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 1.4.0 brings several new features, including the implementation of a mini post-game expansion that adds six new maps, four new defenses, and two new effects; the rebalancing of some final troops that were too strong, bug fixes, and… Lucas now has a voice!

But let’s go step by step. On the weekend of April 5-6, Dos Estrellas will attend the Toledo Matsuri in person. To celebrate, during the two weeks following the release of 1.4.0, there will be an in-game event available from April 3 to April 17.

Toledo Matsuri

During this event, you can unlock up to 6 different skins to dress your troops in a Japanese theme.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/6a7093a14f4c3989172e4ca1b950b9dd66a02e17.png

 Skeletal dogs: Kitsune.
 Emaciated: Kodama.
 Knight: Samurai.
 Banshee: Japanese Ghost.
 Reaper: Shinigami.
 Bothworlder: Tengu.


To unlock these skins, your troops must pass through the Torii scattered across the 6 maps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/903726052ea837f6fcec47a04a9cb10b36679030.png

The Search A mini expansion.

This new content focuses on the Lich’s quest to find an ancient powerful artifact. Will you be able to conquer the new maps and find it? Though… who knows? Maybe the artifact isn’t even in this part of Arreit.

The expansion includes:

Six new maps with volcanic and maritime themes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/62387a7c9fe661ef0f2a53c4eaba973bd9006d10.gif

Four new defenses have been added for the expansion:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/0b4a937ea4e6b561128fa2d970ae4222aa05af17.gif

Lava rivers now cause burns to troops.
Rivers also slow down troop movement across them.

Defense Updates.

Additionally, defenses now take troop type into account, being stronger against some types and weaker against others. To reflect this, defenses now display a sign where you can see their name, damage type, weaknesses, and strengths.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/071f0c0fcfbf0df511b15475edcc02c2c2aca5d2.png

Troop Updates.

Troops also have new information. Now, icons will appear next to them to indicate possible status effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/0f10c1f6bd876a7ffc79ae387445560c296572b3.png

For those who feel this new information clutters the battlefield with too many icons, it can be disabled with a keyboard/controller shortcut.

Both new features are disabled in "hard" difficulty mode.

Rebalancing:

Some troops that were too strong in the late game have been adjusted:

 Dragon now takes twice as long between ability uses.
 Bansheeunit count reduced from 8 to 6 per division.
 Observer unit count reduced from 9 to 6 per division.
 Necromancer summoning soldiers now summons 1 instead of 2.


New Language: Japanese.

Additionally, the game has been fully translated into Japanese! Starting today, you can select this language from the options menu.

Lucas has a voice!

Now Lucas has small voice lines to add more personality to the game. You will hear him during skin selection, skill tree upgrades, and in story events such as capital conquests, the beginning, and the end…

For those who want to hear Lucas everywhere, I’ve enabled the cinematic to replay when reattempting any capital.

I hope you enjoy all these changes and additions. Have fun with the event and 1.4.0!

notes.title: What's Coming in Countless Army's 1.4.0 Update!
notes.content:
The upcoming 1.4.0 update is on its way and will bring improvements and new features.

Mini Expansion Focused on the Lich's Journey

The new update will include a mini expansion called "The Search", where the Lich embarks on a journey in pursuit of a powerful artifact rumored to elevate his powers. Get ready to help the Lich on his quest! This content is designed to expand the game's ending.

Polishing Existing Content

Not only will I focus on new features, but I also plan to spend time polishing all of the current game content, ensuring that every gameplay experience is smoother and more enjoyable than ever.

Rebalancing Troops and Defenses

In this update, I will rebalance troops and defenses as needed, adding or tweaking certain abilities to make battles even more strategic and engaging. This adjustment aims to improve balance and provide more options for every encounter.

Artistic Enhancements

I will continue working to improve the game's aesthetics with adjustments and visual enhancements across several key areas.

Listening to Your Feedback

I've been reading all the reviews and opinions from players to understand what matters most and where I should focus my efforts. But if you have more suggestions on what I should tweak or where I should concentrate, I'll be happy to hear them in the comments. Your feedback is essential to the ongoing improvement of Countless Army.

This update is scheduled to arrive in April.

Stay tuned for more details and get ready for what's coming!

notes.title: 1.3.0 is here!
notes.content:
The 1.3.0 update is here, and with it, Christmas arrives in Countless Army.

Christmas in Countless Army
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/2a6a8b434e321ba334009ab32e4cc2b17a5b57c6.png
In some provinces, snowmen surrounded by candy canes have appeared, bringing joy… But with the magic of the Lich, they will turn into evil snowmen!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7bd4c5d581949bf67c0d07a3dfa27f7d2e8dbdbe.png

New Christmas Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/87538eb919c672c0cef6a237100e7325e9999094.png
Get the 6 exclusive Christmas skins and lead your armies with festive style!

Steam Trading Cards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/5fead44c15b4604dbde2a88319098cd2424c3630.png
Trading Cards are now available in Countless Army. Collect, craft badges, and unlock additional rewards as you play the game.

All collectibles:


 7 emotes
 3 profile backgrounds
 5 badges (& foil version)
 6 cards


Steam Deck Verified
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/5d93773d0df4ab4bf381f12f5d8b2a2c9e5ae59d.png
Countless Army is now officially Steam Deck Verified! Enjoy a smooth and optimized experience on Valve's portable console.

Steam Cloud and Save Improvements
Steam Cloud is now enabled for Countless Army. Play on different devices without worrying about losing your progress. Additionally, adjustments have been made to optimize saved games:

 The risk of corrupted saves has been significantly reduced.
 If an issue occurs, you will have a backup copy to ensure your progress is safe.


Gameplay Improvements
Pause Button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/65f994e21affa32b9fbfb78fd89068c159cd18fd.gif
The Pause Button, suggested by MonkeyFonix, adds a new layer of strategy and convenience. Pause the game to think carefully and plan your moves. This improvement is especially useful for players using a controller.

Army Templates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/b372de4c9d3392b093a2d0f9b43391a7dfaa3c5c.gif
Inspired by McStuffins T. Fox's suggestion, you can now save troop configurations. This feature simplifies the start of invasions by allowing you to reuse your favorite setups.

Prefer experimenting with new strategies or not saving templates? You can disable this option from the upper left corner of the troop selection screen.

Shortcut List
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/a156936947e9d8cd864a6c7df9b8a61c605cbee4.png
Thanks to Lavan's proposal, you can now view all available shortcuts directly from the options menu. Whether you're using a keyboard or controller, this functionality will help you get the most out of your games.

Two New Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/e2c2248c3e79a2c9866f336e3be6402f169b4d0e.png
Two new skins inspired by Dead Inside Gaming and Interndotgif have been added. Customize your armies with these fresh options!

Demo Update
The demo has also been updated to reflect all the changes made to the game. This includes new gameplay mechanics, bug fixes, and general optimizations.

More Details in the Patch Notes
These are the highlights of version 1.3.0, but if you want to dive into all the changes and adjustments, don’t forget to check out the complete patch notes!

notes.title: Getting Closer to Update 1.3.0!
notes.content:
The 1.3.0 update is just around the corner, and today I want to share some of the exciting features coming your way.

Pause Button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/65f994e21affa32b9fbfb78fd89068c159cd18fd.gif

The pause button was suggested by "MonkeyFonix", and I thought it was a fantastic idea. After exploring how to implement it, I realized that this mechanic not only adds an extra layer of strategy and tactics to the game but also improves the experience for players using a controller. I’m confident many of you will find it both useful!


Army Templates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/b372de4c9d3392b093a2d0f9b43391a7dfaa3c5c.gif

Thanks to the suggestion from "McStuffins T. Fox", a system to save troop configurations has been added. When you select your troops for an invasion, the configuration will now be automatically saved for future invasions, making it much easier to get started.
For those experimenting with different strategies or who simply prefer not to save their configurations, there’s an option to disable this feature. You can find it at the top left of the troop selection screen.


Shortcut List
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/519047df2bf9351b5ec9f9d4e64ff37ef47b1ef7.gif

"Lavan" suggested adding a section in the options menu to display all the shortcuts available in the game. They noticed that some commands weren’t explained in the tutorial, and they were absolutely right. This is a feature that should have been there from the beginning.
After working on its development, I’m happy to present the result! You can now easily check all the shortcuts, whether for keyboard or controller, directly from the options menu.

I hope these new features excite you as much as they do me. The Christmas update will bring even more surprises! Stay tuned for more information coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/da16899e1c5273e82f949c1a3ef21acf58f9f711.png

notes.title: Improvements to Save Systems
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Over the past few days, I’ve been fully focused on resolving the issues related to the save system.

The two main challenges were corrupted saves and Steam Cloud integration. I’m happy to announce with a big smile that both issues are now resolved! (or at least they should be).

Additionally, I’ve made some adjustments to the auto-save system. These changes not only improve how it works but also optimize the game’s performance by limiting how often it saves. The game should now run a bit smoother!

Steam Cloud Saves
Steam Cloud saving is still in the testing phase. Although I’ve spent several days testing it with positive results, I want to be completely transparent: while this feature is in Open Beta, I cannot guarantee that save files won’t be lost. To be safe, I recommend making backups of your saves before trying it out.

How to Test These Improvements?
If you’d like to test these new features, you can join the Open Beta. Here’s a link with instructions on how to access it.

Thank you for your continued support and for playing Countless Army. See you in the next invasion!

notes.title: What’s Coming in 1.3.0
notes.content:
Almost a month ago, 1.2.0 was released, bringing the Halloween event, controller support, rebellion rebalancing, accessibility options, and the release of the game for Mac and Linux. However, some features planned for that version couldn’t make it due to various reasons. But don’t worry! If everything goes as planned, they’ll be ready for 1.3.0.

Today, I want to share what’s coming in this next update. While some details are "top secret," I can share several exciting features that are already in progress.

New Features

 Demo Update: The demo will be updated to include all the improvements.
 Steam Deck Support: My goal is to make Countless Army fully compatible with Steam Deck, and in this update, I’ll work towards obtaining official verification. (Carried over from 1.2.0.)
 Shortcut Visualization in the Options Menu: Suggested by "Lavan." As Lavan pointed out, there are shortcuts that are undocumented. To address this, a section will be added in the options menu to display all keyboard and controller shortcuts. (Carried over from 1.2.0.)
 Button to Retain Army Configuration: Suggested by "McStuffins T. Fox." This feature will let you reuse your previous troop configuration, streamlining the process for players with an already-defined strategy. (Carried over from 1.2.0.)
 Button to End the Current Wave: Also suggested by "McStuffins T. Fox." This button will allow you to instantly finish a wave once you’ve achieved your objectives, eliminating all current troops on the battlefield and moving directly to the next wave. (Carried over from 1.2.0.)
 Pause Button: Another idea by "McStuffins T. Fox." This button will allow you to pause the game, making it easier to strategize and cast spells at critical moments. (Carried over from 1.2.0.)


Changes

 Improved typography for better clarity and readability.
 Review of defense attacks, especially their behavior at higher speeds.
 These are the planned features and changes for 1.3.0. As I mentioned earlier, there are additional features in development that I can’t reveal yet, but I’ll share more news in the coming weeks as everything progresses.


Thank you for your support and for enjoying Countless Army. See you in the next invasion!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2
notes.content:
These fixes address the errors reported during this week following the launch of the Halloween event (1.2.0).

Bugs:


 In the map "Cuerno Island," there is a path to rare items at the end (reported by "Jesus101").
 One of the maps in the 6th kingdom could not be replayed (reported by "Biscark").
 The troops: Banshee, Standard Bearer, Observer, Mass and Necromancer displayed different classes in different locations (reported by "idiot5k").
 An error in the map "The Confluence" had an issue with route 2, the one with the mills (it was not well defined) (reported by "idiot5k").
 The achievements related to map difficulty only unlocked if you right-clicked with the mouse and not with any other button in the victory menu.
 The cannon did not fire when the game was at speed x6.
 The achievements for difficulty by capital were not activated.


Regarding the last fix, I am not entirely sure it has been resolved, as it is an error that, no matter how much I try to fix, I cannot seem to solve. However, on this last occasion, I was testing several things, and thanks to a user ("Tekarin"), I was able to confirm that the error comes from the capital of Kingdom 3. Apparently, the data for which level you completed this capital is not being saved correctly.

If it is still not fixed, I would greatly appreciate it if you could report it to me again. I would also like to mention that if I have not managed to fix it yet, you can unlock those achievements by replaying the capital of Kingdom 3 one last time, as even if the data is not saved, you would meet the requirements to achieve the achievements within the same game session.

Thank you very much to everyone who reports errors and helps make the game more polished!

notes.title: Launch of version 1.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/5f1308b5b90565fd0c6b86603f11395af9835945.png
Halloween has arrived in Countless Army!

With the launch of version 1.2.0, Halloween is upon us! In some maps, there are special pumpkins that seem to absorb the Lich spell power. The story tells that if you feed them, you will obtain up to six unique skins, only available during the event! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/e100de0419b61c8667159db7cd413ff6b69cbc4e.jpg
The event starts on October 26 and ends on November 4.

With the update, there are also some new features, but not as many as I'd like since time was a bit limited. Here are the highlights of version 1.2.0:

The launch of Countless Army on Mac and Linux! Now you can also enjoy Countless Army on those platforms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/339c66d88d99f2717070f7a610488f3200978287.gif

Control support. Now the game is fully playable with a control. Enjoy it with your favorite control!

The rebellions have been reduced. Now the rebellions pop up with less frequency in the gray skulls and even less in the yellow skulls. The rebel provinces with 3 stars are now also marked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/74155bbe0de03c5ffe839ea04a39d7a3554cfe8f.jpg

Replay maps without a rebellion. Do you want to get three stars in each map but don’t want them to rebel? Do you want to look for the Halloween pumpkins and have everything conquered? Go ahead, now it is possible! However, if the map isn’t one that has rebelled, it won't grant you resources.

Reset button for the skill tree. Now the skill tree has a button to reset it, granting you the spent essences. It has a cost depending on how many upgrades you have.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7dfcdce8d1308c60f122ccd42a7beaeff5c07d79.jpg

I’m sorry I couldn’t add everything mentioned in this version, but don’t worry, in version 1.3.0, all that couldn’t make it to this will come along with some other features!

If you want to know each and every change, here are the patch notes.

Thanks a lot to everyone for being there and enjoying the Halloween event!

notes.title: Things 1.2.0 will bring
notes.content:
The 1.1.0 was launched two weeks ago, this update brought a lot of new things. Such as a new cover image, new transition, new victory screen, more sounds… And in general a lot of things to excite the player experience.
Sadly with this update there were a bunch of errors that have been reported. The biggest have been fixed thanks to a hotfix  I tried to make the fastest I could, but some small ones could be there while I’m still trying to fix them.

But I think it is time to work on version 1.2.0. And here I’ll leave a tentative content in the update. I have to say that various things have been proposed by you, the players. I’ve been reading each comment that you post, because they help me to improve the Countless Army.


The 1.2.0 will bring:

New things:

 Controller support. To give more options to players, adding the possibility to play with a joystick seems essential.
 Support for Steam Deck. My idea was to make Countless Army compatible with the console, and for the next update I want to do it.
 A button to reset the skill tree (Proposed by “Lavan”). As Lavan mentioned, the profession is something that you feel more than read, because you don’t know how they will fit on your composition until you try it. To change the elections on the skill tree, a button to reset it is a good gamble.
 See all the shortcuts on the option menu(proposed by Lavan). Lavan mentions that there’s some shortcut that isn’t mentioned in any place and he is right. To afford this I added an option to said menu to see every keyboard shortcut or from the controller.
 A button to keep the army configuration (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). As McStuffins T. Fox mentions, actually if you use an army configuration that works and you don’t want to change it, a button to use the same army from a previous invasion is a very good idea to speed up the troop selection.
 A button to end the actual wave (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). On some occasions we find that the objective has been conquered way easier than we thought previously, and then we have to wait until the wave ends to start the next one. With this  button all the troops that are in the battlefield will die, and the ones that aren’t on it will disappear, giving place to the end of that wave.
 A pause button (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). As he says, if you play at high speed sometimes you can’t think in which place you want your spells. For that a pause button will bring more strategy, pausing the game and launching the spells thinking better each movement.



Changes:

 Reduce rebellions. They are an important part of the game, but it is true that they happen more often than I like. For this reason the same will be reduced.
 The not upgradable stats will also be visible (*roposed by Lavan). Some units don't upgrade some stats and actually they can’t be seen. Lavan mentions that those should be visible even if you can’t upgrade them to compare it and then make better strategies. This will change making them visible.



All this new stuff and changes are the ones planned and I’ll try to bring in the 1.2.0. There’s more proposals and ideas that I’m still thinking about, so it is possible new ones could be added on the way.

This update is planned for Halloween week, at the end of the next month. 

I’ll keep you updated about my work each week, as I did with the 1.1.0.

Thanks you all a lot for being here, enjoying Countless Army!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.3
notes.content:
Today the version 1.1.3 of Countless Army is released, a little hotfix to the biggest errors that you all reported.
This one is focused on fixing the bugs that could make the game crash or that don’t allow you to play the game correctly. I’m reading everything you write and taking notes of the faults, even the ones that are little to fix them, but I’m doing it in order. I’m also reading all of your opinions and shortly I’ll post a new notice talking about the things the version 1.2 will bring. I’ve readed a lot of good ideas!

So, let’s see the changes and errors fixed:

Changes:

 I’ve changed the way the game is compilated, this should make it be better optimized, allowing it to work in each dispositive and give less non consistent errors.
 The speed x8 that unlocks in the end game has been changed to x 6. The x8 made a lot of error(is still in test, it can give some errors but less than the x8).


bugs:

 The drake has an error when you summoned it, making everything after it to not be summoned.
 The necromancer had the CD wrong when you summoned it.
 The drake icon wasn’t visible in the upgrades from the conquerable buildings.
 In the capital of the kingdom 2 the 2nd runic camp was conquered when the troops walked over the route on it.
 A visual bug where the shields appears under the troop.
 The tutorial sometimes crashed on the first wave.
 The necromancer could make the game crash if he made a summon when he entered to conquer a building.
 The mass could crash the game if died when he entered a building.
 The tutorial didn’t get the golden skull if you have the map in 100%(don’t worry, if you get the golden skill in the other maps the tutorial one will change to gold for the achievement of getting all the maps to 100%).
 Sometimes when you realize any action in an invasion the wave sign could disappear making it impossible to start a new wave.
 The troops count to win a map could be negative.
 The dragon could die in the defense “trench” of one hit.


Again, thanks a lot to all for reporting the bugs and for adding suggestions, it helps me a lot!

notes.content:

 Added minimaps to kingdoms 3, 4 and 5.
 If the harder difficulty is chosen the minimaps are disabled.
 Improved the sound of troops updating.
 Added two new skins to each unit: 
 Soldier “Dorwulf”
 Soldier “Pirate”

 Improvement to the tutorial map(Brute’s Forest).

 Improvement to the tutorial map(The Confluence)

Fixed bugs:

 The skull of "Horn island" was under the terrain border.
 The skull of "The Rhodes" was under the terrain border.
 Sometimes the shield from the spell and the from the lumberjack were hanging after the death of a troop.
 The defense “trench” was blurred when the map started.
 The camera of skill tree were moving more that it needed(There was a kind of space to the sides)
 The cards that got smaller or bigger if you zoomed in or out while the cards change(spell to troops and troops to spell)  
 Sometimes, with specific conditions, the purchases on the skill tree could stay locked.
 Sometimes the spell upgrades were already acquired.
 In some maps the roads were poorly defined.
 In some maps some floor parts were placed wrong.
 The “bridges” on the small rivers sometimes could be seen over the troops and other decorations.
 The difficulty button in options sometimes had an error.
 If you win the six capital in “hard” the achievements of difficulty “easy” and “normal” weren’t unlocked.
 Some skins of the Standard bearer didn’t have death animation.
 The troop’s hitbox sometimes received more hits than it was meant to.
 The shadows of some troops didn’t appear as they should.
 The updates of conquering a build that could crash the game.
 Sometimes the upgrade number was corrupted, giving errors to the system of difficulty and their achievements.
 The music in the intro and some other occasions didn’t play.
 One of the conquerabled buildings of the second kingdom’s capital was conquered by itself.

notes.title: What 1.1.0 will contain
notes.content:
Hello!

As you sure know, the 1.0.0 has been launched some time ago(in fact, some bug fixes has been raised it to 1.0.2)

And I want to bring you the update of the roadmap, more specifically what 1.1.0 will contain.

1.1.0 will bring:

 New animations in some points of the game.
 New animations on the interface to make visually more clear what you are doing
 Minimaps in the selection of kingdoms 3, 4, 5, y 6.
 Cloud save
 A new unit
 Two skins to buy in each troop(If you have any idea let me know, I’ll have it in mind)
 Fix of the cards mechanics making it able to buy new ones without acquire new troops before, and even start maps without all the troops.


Looking at people’s opinions, I realized that some animations are needed to better visualize some things on the interface and when you play. I’m still thinking how to improve them, also I’ll make news to show the advances.

I hope to bring this update at the end of August, but I’m not 100% sure about this, being only one developer the times fly away and its complicated. But be sure it will arrive!

Surely it’ll have some other added thing, I’ll be informing about.

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Steam achievements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The game has been updated today to 1.0.0. Besides things already mentioned in the roadmap, I bring some troop changes for balance and other that Josef_the_tall in the general discussions on Steam. In these notes I added the previous changes made on monday and tuesday.

Patch notes of version 1.0.0

 Steam achievements.
 The banshee has been reduced from 10 to 8 in quantity.
 The observer has been reduced from 10 to 8 in quantity.
 The standard bearer has been reduced from 2 to 1 in quantity.
 The standard bearer has seen his influence zone x3.
 The mega troop isn’t limited to 1 in each wave.
 The mega troop now can be changed in any moment for other.
 Finished the capitals conquer scenes.
 The conquer scenes has been optimized( they had a little lag).
 Bug fixed that allowed you to buy new cards even if you don’t have the troops to use them, making that the player can’t continue playing.
 Added an option to change letters font.
 Added an option to choose game difficulty. Being able to play in easy(-40% damage), normal(the current version of the game) and hard(+20% damage).
 The first two maps have been changed to be more accessible. They weren’t impossible but not for much.
 Professions skin (Bothworlder).
 Professions skin (Mass).
 Professions skin (Observer).
 Professions skin (Necromancer).
 Bothworlder’s visual noise was reduced. Visually it annoyed a lot in map.
 Mill’s healing zone was reduced. Being so big and healing so much it was too much healing.
 Bug fix that made the game be bigger than it needed.
 Bug fix of an update of the dogs that seems it was free(the resource however was reduced as intended).
 Bug fix in easy difficulty that prevented the tutorial from advancing once you summoned two soldiers divisions in the first wave.


This update has almost everything that I wanted to add to it. I still need the final scene and credits, sadly it didn’t make it on time. When I have it I’ll add it in a new update!

I’ll be working on the other things added to the roadmap. Also, I’m reading about what anyone writes about the game. Opinions, suggestions and more, all this can be helpful to improve the game. 

See you soon!!

notes.content:
Hi again!

Today I bring another fast update to fix a bug that I’ve been informed is preventing the tutorial from advancing in easy difficulty. I’m also working in the friday update, however some things that you’ll have from now:


Changelog version 0.9.3

 Professions skin (Bothworlder)
 Professions skin (Mass)
 Professions skin (Observer)
 Professions skin (Necromancer)

Today I’ve been working on the troops' professions that didn’t have skin, so they will be added to the update. Besides some other bug fixes or little changes in the game.

A user in general discussions (Josef_the_tall) has mentioned a bug referring to troops and cards, when if you buy more cards than troops you can select the game “breaks” and you can’t keep playing. I’m working on it and I hope to fix it soon. 

Thank you a lot to all of you that keep commenting on the game errors!

notes.title: Notes of version 0.9.2:
notes.content:
Hello! 

I’ve had some complaints about the difficulty, and even if I want a game that is a little complicated, I don’t want to leave people without playing Countless Army because of this. For this reason and even if a big update is coming on the freeday,  I want to bring you this quick update to fix it.

Notes of version 0.9.2:

 Added an option to change letters font.
 Added an option to choose game difficulty. Being able to play in easy(-40% damage), normal(the current version of the game) and hard(+20% damage).
 The first two maps have been changed to be more accessible. They weren’t impossible but not for much.


I recommend playing the easy difficulty for those that aren’t very familiar with strategy games or to people that can’t get through the normal difficulty.
The normal difficulty is the one in which the game was designed originally and is the one in which I think the game has to be played.
The hard difficulty is not fully tested, so I’m working on it.


Even the difficulty and the letters font can be changed in the option menu in any moment:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/52e73718a902d8d029982a207d85a5bac69a3d10.jpg

Besides this you have to choose a difficulty at the start of each game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7986b9c68f7a4707bb4dcd2560ff36970214d06e.jpg

I hope this gets better access to new players.

I love to receive your comments about the new difficulty modes, to know if they are balanced or are very easy/very hard to balance them better.

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey!

Yesterday, Countless Army came out and with such nervousness of launching my first game I forgot many things, between them launching this notice with the roadmap.

On this, I’ll be showing the things that will be included in the game with time:

Version 1.0.0


 Upgrade to the conquest scenes
 Steam achievements
 Final credits
 Final Scene
 Profession skins
 Difficulty balance
 Option button to choose font weight, lighter or heavier
 Option button to make the game easier or harder


I know that the achievements are something that many people love, and I want them in the game. I didn’t make it to the launch day, but be sure you are going to see them!

I talk about upgrading conquest scenes, credits and final scenes. The same thing happened here with achievements, I didn't make it on time.

This version is going to come out on the 26 of July. Is very close to the release date, but being things that I believe are basics, I want you to have them as soon as I can.


Version 1.1.0


 Cloud save
 A new troop, unlockable at the end of the game
 Two new skin for each troop


The new unit will be, initially, oriented to those that want to have the full progress of the game, my idea is that I’ll be fun to play(almost as easy mode) and about the skins…The best way to show off your troops is with new aspects!

Version 1.2.0


 Steam Deck compatibility
 Controller compatibility


This two last updates don’t have launch date yet, because I don’t know how much time I’ll spend on implement them, but be sure my idea is update them soon.

I want to mention too, this are the thing planned right now, but they won’t be the last updates for the game, I plan to release thematic skins from time to time, fix bugs that appears and implement maps, troops and defense balance that can hurt the game in some way

Also, today I made a little update, this is because the game was easier than  I wanted at first and it has been upgraded a little for all the game

I hope you are enjoying the game!
Thanks a lot to all!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.6.0 (Demo)
notes.content:
Patch notes:

 Changes in the summoning system. Now it works in waves.
 Changes on the interface to include the waves system.
 Now the map needs a certain number of troops getting in the end to conquer it.

 The cards now show their back side to show that they aren’t usable at that moment.

notes.title: Demo update, weather and fish
notes.content:

Today I came to show some updates to the Demo, you can try them already in the game.

I balanced the first kingdom, to make the difficulty more suitable to an “introduction” to the game. This way this kingdom offers a better experience.

The tutorial now is shorter, now it takes half of the time and it is “lighter”.

Some visual effects were added, to give more immersion to the world. The first one if the climate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/d79a2fcb892b88580e9f3cf37e7b032dce1977e1.gif

The second: fishes. They are on the rivers to give them more life, and aslo some new effects were added to the water.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/c2f523b3e3e9a1537b2450089ed3c90de3d0af27.gif

Also, some bugs that I found were fixed, and other changes to make yout gaming experience better.

At the same time, I’ve been working on the balance of the 2nd kingdom and the creation of the 3th kingdom, soon I’ll bring another update where I’ll show something of it.

For the moment, here is where the update ends, I hope that everyone than plays it like it and I’m waiting for you to tell me how it looks!
